designer.bpmn.banner.subtitle: Drag an element from the palette to begin.
designer.bpmn.banner.title: BPMN-Lite editor
designer.bpmn.boundary.label.description: Optional human-readable name displayed below the event.
designer.bpmn.boundary.label.label: Label
designer.bpmn.boundary.subtype.descripti: What interrupts the host activity. Changing this re-types the event in place.
designer.bpmn.boundaryEvent.message.name: Name the inbound message must carry to fire this boundary while the host is live.
OrderCancelled
Broadcast name. Fires whenever a matching signal is broadcast while the host is live.
ISO-8601 literal (PT15M, R3/PT10M) or an EL expression. The clock starts when the host activity begins.
designer.bpmn.callActivity.label.descrip: Optional human-readable name shown inside the activity.
designer.bpmn.callActivity.label.label: Label
designer.bpmn.catchEvent.label.descripti: Optional human-readable name displayed below the event.
designer.bpmn.catchEvent.label.label: Label
designer.bpmn.catchEvent.subtype.descrip: What the token waits for. Changing this re-types the event in place.
designer.bpmn.endEvent.label.description: Optional human-readable name displayed below the event.
designer.bpmn.endEvent.label.label: Label
designer.bpmn.eventBasedGateway.label.de: Optional human-readable name displayed below the gateway. Each outgoing branch must target an intermediate timer, message or signal catch event; the first to fire cancels its siblings.
designer.bpmn.exclusiveGateway.label.des: Optional human-readable name (e.g. the decision question).
designer.bpmn.field.calledElement.descri: Definition key of the workflow to run as a child process. Resolved against its CURRENTLY-DEPLOYED version each time the call runs, so redeploying the callee changes what later calls execute. The caller waits until the child instance finishes; data crosses only through declared input/output mappings.
designer.bpmn.field.calledElement.label: Called definition
designer.bpmn.field.condition.descriptio: Expression evaluated when the source is an exclusive gateway. The flow is taken when truthy.
designer.bpmn.field.condition.expression: EL expression re-evaluated when process variables change; the token resumes when it becomes true.
designer.bpmn.field.condition.label: Condition
designer.bpmn.field.direction.descriptio: Diverging forks the flow into its outgoing branches; Converging joins incoming branches back together.
designer.bpmn.field.direction.label: Direction
designer.bpmn.field.errorCode.descriptio: BPMN errorRef to catch. Leave blank to catch ANY error from the host. The engine allows error boundaries on service tasks only.
designer.bpmn.field.errorCode.label: Error code
designer.bpmn.field.formKey.description: FormModule definition id rendered by the Inbox when the user opens the task.
designer.bpmn.field.formKey.label: Form key
designer.bpmn.field.implementation.descr: Service-task handler key dispatched by the engine. Picks from the live `coolms.workflow.handler` registry.
designer.bpmn.field.implementation.label: Implementation
designer.bpmn.field.interrupting.checkbo: Cancels the host activity when it fires
designer.bpmn.field.interrupting.descrip: On: firing cancels the host activity (solid ring). Off: the host keeps running (dashed ring). The engine requires message boundaries to be non-interrupting and error boundaries to be interrupting.
designer.bpmn.field.interrupting.label: Interrupting
designer.bpmn.field.isDefault.descriptio: When the source is an exclusive gateway and no other outgoing condition matches, this flow is taken.
designer.bpmn.field.isDefault.label: Default flow
designer.bpmn.field.loopCollection.descr: Optional. EL yielding a list; the activity then runs once per item, in order. Leave blank for a normal single run. An empty list at runtime skips the activity entirely.
designer.bpmn.field.loopCollection.label: Repeat over (collection)
designer.bpmn.field.loopCompletionCondit: Optional EL re-checked after each iteration; when true the loop stops before the collection is exhausted (e.g. "two approvals are enough").
Process-variable name the current item is written to before each iteration. Defaults to "item".
Process variable matched against the message payload to pick the right instance.
designer.bpmn.field.message.name.label: Message name
designer.bpmn.field.signal.name.label: Signal name
designer.bpmn.field.subtype.label: Event type
designer.bpmn.field.timer.kind.descripti: Duration waits a relative span; Date waits until an instant; Cycle repeats.
designer.bpmn.field.timer.kind.label: Timer type
designer.bpmn.field.timer.value.label: Timer expression
designer.bpmn.field.variant.label: Task type
designer.bpmn.inclusiveGateway.label.des: Optional human-readable name displayed below the gateway.
designer.bpmn.intermediateCatchEvent.mes: Name the inbound message must carry to wake this token.
designer.bpmn.intermediateCatchEvent.sig: Broadcast name. Signals carry no correlation key -- every waiting token with this name resumes.
designer.bpmn.intermediateCatchEvent.tim: ISO-8601 literal (PT15M, 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, R3/PT10M) or an EL expression resolved when the token arrives.
designer.bpmn.serviceTask.label.descript: Name displayed inside the task box.
designer.bpmn.serviceTask.label.label: Name
designer.bpmn.serviceTask.variant.descri: Pick "User task" to surface a form key; "Service task" to surface an implementation key.
designer.bpmn.startEvent.label.descripti: Optional human-readable name displayed below the event.
designer.bpmn.startEvent.label.label: Label
designer.bpmn.subProcess.label.descripti: Optional name for this block of work, shown at the top-left of the container. Drop elements inside the box to put them in the scope; the token entering the subprocess waits until everything inside it finishes.
designer.bpmn.subProcess.label.label: Label
designer.bpmn.task.label.description: Name displayed inside the task box.
designer.bpmn.task.label.label: Name
designer.bpmn.task.variant.description: User task surfaces a form key; service task surfaces an implementation key. Plain task is a placeholder for hand-tuned definitions.
designer.bpmn.userTask.label.description: Name displayed inside the task box.
designer.bpmn.userTask.label.label: Name
designer.bpmn.userTask.variant.descripti: Pick "User task" to surface a form key; "Service task" to surface an implementation key.
designer.drd.banner.subtitle: Add a decision or input to start modelling your DRD
designer.drd.banner.title: Decision Requirements editor
designer.drd.diagram.name.description: The DecisionDefinition.definitionKey this DRD deploys as.
designer.drd.diagram.name.label: Definition key
designer.drd.element.decisionLogicRef.de: The decisionTable definition key supplying this decision's logic. Blank means the logic is authored elsewhere.
designer.drd.element.name.description.de: The decision name — what this node decides.
designer.drd.element.name.description.in: The input-data name — the raw fact this node supplies to the decisions that require it.
designer.drd.element.name.label: Name
designer.drd.requirement.from.descriptio: The source node — the Decision or InputData this requirement depends on.
designer.drd.requirement.from.label: From (required)
designer.drd.requirement.to.description: The decision that requires the source. The arrow points into it.
designer.drd.requirement.to.label: To (requiring decision)
designer.sm.banner.subtitle: Add a place to start modelling your state machine
designer.sm.banner.title: State Machine editor
designer.sm.field.auditTrail.description: Symfony audit_trail.enabled — emit an audit log row per transition.
designer.sm.field.auditTrail.label: Audit trail
designer.sm.field.from.label: From
designer.sm.field.guard.description: Symfony EL — e.g. subject.totalAmount > 0 or is_granted('ROLE_MANAGER'). Blank means the transition is always allowed.
designer.sm.field.guard.label: Guard
designer.sm.field.initial.description: Symfony initial_marking. A state machine has exactly one — turning this on clears it on the previous initial place.
designer.sm.field.initial.label: Initial state
designer.sm.field.markingProperty.descri: The entity property holding the current state (marking_store.property).
designer.sm.field.markingProperty.label: Marking property
designer.sm.field.name.label: Name
designer.sm.field.supports.description: One fully-qualified class name per line.
designer.sm.field.supports.label: Supports (entity classes)
designer.sm.field.to.label: To
designer.sm.field.workflowName.label: Workflow name
designer.sm.place.name.description: The place (state) name — used verbatim in the Symfony places list and referenced by transitions.
designer.sm.transition.name.description: The transition name — the verb that moves between states.
designer.toolbar.connect: Connect mode — draw flows between elements
designer.toolbar.hand: Hand tool — drag to pan the canvas
